summary: Full pre-publish regression on Signature Realty CRM against https://signature-props.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend pytest suite (backend_test.py) refreshed to match PIN-login (Google removed) and expanded to cover builder-projects & broker-network — 22 passed, 1 skipped (site-visit create requires an engine-generated MatchID, kept as contract skip). Frontend Playwright e2e in real Chromium: unauth redirect to /login.html?next=/clients works; wrong PIN 0000 shows 'Invalid code. Please try again.' via [data-testid=login-status]; PIN 1234 auto-submits and lands on '/'; dashboard renders stat cards (Total Leads, Inventory, Builder Projects, Site Visits) and full nav (Dashboard, Clients, Inventory, Requirements, Duplicates, Builder Projects, Broker Network, Calculators, Digital Card) with NO Gethub entry; every nav route returns HTTP 200 without landing on /login or /gethub; /gethub and /gethub.html still 302-redirect; GET /api/dashboard ok:true; GET /api/site-visits 200 ok:true. Loopback ADMIN session verified CRUD create+persist for /api/leads and /api/inventory, plus list for /api/requirements and creation of a requirement bound to the created lead. One real (non-blocking) frontend defect found on Digital Card: /vendor/qrcode.js and /vendor/html2canvas.min.js return 404 (with MIME-type refuse-to-execute errors), so the QR code and 'Download Card Image' features cannot render on that page. Everything else is production-ready.

ui_bugs.issue: /vendor/qrcode.js and /vendor/html2canvas.min.js return 404, QR code image is broken and 'Download Card Image' will fail (html2canvas missing).
ui_bugs.selector: /digital-card page — img inside .SCAN TO WHATSAPP block and Download Card Image button

issues: CSP still blocks static.cloudflareinsights.com beacon (cosmetic console noise, pre-existing from iterations 2/3, not a regression).

action_items: Digital Card: either ship /vendor/qrcode.js and /vendor/html2canvas.min.js (or switch to CDN URLs allowed by CSP) so the QR image and 'Download Card Image' actually work. Currently both 404 and the QR slot is empty in the rendered page.
critical_code_review_comments: PIN-login endpoint /api/auth/pin-login exhibited one transient 500 during retesting on the preview URL (curl and immediate retries returned 200). Consider adding a small retry/backoff at the FastAPI proxy or investigating the intermittent upstream error — not reproducible reliably.

Digital Card page depends on local /vendor/qrcode.js and /vendor/html2canvas.min.js which are missing from the deployed static assets. Either commit these vendored files or serve via CDN with an updated CSP.

Site-visit creation requires a pre-existing engine-generated MatchID; there is no simple API path for a UI/backend caller to create one directly from lead+requirement+property. If the UI supports scheduling a visit, verify the match flow is discoverable — otherwise this is confusing.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows pass; Digital Card QR/Download broken due to missing vendor JS)
